[XENIOS MANUAL ORDER WORKER HANDOFF]

SESSION: claude-fable-s3
LANE: admin + customer order email completeness (the founder's new #1)
BRANCH: fable/admin-order-email-completeness-20260821
BASE SHA: 6291242ac4f4 (pushed origin head)
PUSHED SHA: ac64a59acb8a9f1aa5edb6dc20eece043159c850
PRODUCTION MUTATED: NO. No route registration, no migration, no real email, no flag.

CUSTOMER OUTCOME ENABLED: the founder can now fulfil an order from the email alone, without opening the database.

FILES: server/research/assisted-order/communications.ts + .test.ts, server/research/assisted-order/service.ts + .test.ts

WORK COMPLETED. Admin email now carries, on top of what it had: phone (or 'Phone: not provided' rather than an omitted row), organization, full shipping address, order total said as a total, every accepted agreement at its exact published version AND acceptance time, the general note and any per-line note, and Status: Order Received / Awaiting Manual Review. Customer email now says 'Order received', that Xenios will confirm availability and email payment instructions, and that the order is not confirmed or shipped until contacted; it never says paid, confirmed, in stock or shipped.

POLICY REVERSAL YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT, because it changes a stated privacy boundary. communications.ts previously documented that NO shipping or billing address could reach ANY email, and two tests asserted it — communications.test.ts 'leaks no procurement economics' and service.test.ts 'persists before notifications'. The founder's manual-fulfilment decision reverses that for the ADMIN email only. I INVERTED both assertions in place and quoted the old expectation in a comment rather than deleting them, so this reads as a reversal and not as quietly dropped coverage. The file header is rewritten to say the boundary is now deliberately asymmetric. If the founder did not intend the address in email, revert this commit — it is self-contained.

THE CUSTOMER HALF IS PINNED HARDER THAN BEFORE: the customer payload is now asserted to carry NONE of shippingAddress, mobilePhone, agreements, declaredAffiliateCode, affiliateAttributionRef, adminPath, orderStatusLabel. Admin lines are built separately from customer lines so the per-line note reaches the operator only. Still out of BOTH: cost, margin, markup, multiplier, supplier identity, identity-document bytes/paths, payment evidence.

FIXED WHILE HERE: the admin template's filter dropped every deliberate blank line, so the email rendered as one unbroken wall. Only genuinely absent lines are dropped now. A human reads this one by hand and a wall is how a shipping address gets misread.

TESTS: 194 assisted-order server tests pass (9 files). Mutation-checked: removing shippingAddress from the admin payload fails the suite.

KNOWN BLOCKERS: none for this branch. NOTE the declared affiliate code renders as 'customer-entered "DANA10" (unverified)' and stays separate from verified attribution — unchanged, and I did not touch any partners path.

INTEGRATION INSTRUCTIONS: merge the branch. Nothing to mount. Rows queued before this change still render (the new fields are all optional and absent-safe) — covered by a test.

ALSO STILL PENDING FROM ME, unmerged: d1a92698 (EA sign-out was leaving the previous customer's status token — a bearer credential — in a shared browser; also carries the member-JWT fix that makes signed-in members see their approved price instead of 'Price on request'). And RETRACT 34ad47cf: general-platform-20's path-overlap module at 6291242 is better than mine and is already integrated; my branch would conflict.
